headline: Crude Oil Prices Decline as Supply Glut Concerns Outweigh Middle East Risks
summary: Crude oil prices extended losses as growing concerns over a global supply glut outweighed risks from attacks on shipping in the Persian Gulf and Saudi energy infrastructure. Brent crude traded at $91.70 per barrel.
why: Crude oil is the world's most traded commodity and a primary driver of global transportation costs, energy sector earnings, and headline inflation.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Rising evidence of a global crude oil glut pushed Brent crude futures lower.
